result.summary: Overall layout looks mostly clean; found a couple of minor duplicate-content and inconsistency issues in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical entries for 'Green Bowl Poke' with the same image, delivery time, and price, which looks like a duplication error rather than two distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Verify backend data to ensure unique restaurant listings are shown, or replace with a different restaurant if duplication is unintended.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card is white/outlined while on the pizza card below it appears in a dark circle, creating inconsistent icon styling across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon's background and color treatment across all promotional cards for visual consistency.
